claims.natural_statement: For every n=2^r with r>=2, the accepted actual paired elliptic sphere-family construction gives an infinite pro-2 quotient Q with dense punctured fiber image, finite images of all boundary meridians, trivial distinguished vertical meridians, and a finite parameter cover of distinguished ramification index exactly two.

For arbitrary groups G,Q,P and homomorphisms rho:G->Q and p:Q->P, if p is injective on every subgroup A_i, every s in S has rho(s) conjugate to an element of some A_i, and p(rho(s))=1, then normalClosure(S) lies in ker(rho) and rho descends to G/normalClosure(S). For any f:G->Q with image in a detected A_i, ker(p composed with f)=ker(f).
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib.GroupTheory.QuotientGroup.Basic

namespace SurfaceGeometry

universe u v w z

variable {G : Type u} {Q : Type v} {P : Type w} {I : Type z}
variable [Group G] [Group Q] [Group P]

theorem local_kernel_agreement
    (f : G →* Q) (p : Q →* P) (A : Subgroup Q)
    (himage : ∀ g, f g ∈ A)
    (hdetect : Set.InjOn p (A : Set Q)) :
    (p.comp f).ker = f.ker := by
  ext g
  change p (f g) = 1 ↔ f g = 1
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact hdetect (himage g) A.one_mem (by simpa using h)
  · intro h
    simp [h]

theorem conjugate_kernel_trivial
    (p : Q →* P) (A : Subgroup Q)
    (hdetect : Set.InjOn p (A : Set Q))
    {a : Q} (ha : a ∈ A) (g : Q)
    (h : p (g * a * g⁻¹) = 1) :
    g * a * g⁻¹ = 1 := by
  have hp : p a = 1 := by
    have h' := congrArg (fun t : P => (p g)⁻¹ * t * p g) h
    simpa [map_mul, map_inv, mul_assoc] using h'
  have haone : a = 1 :=
    hdetect ha A.one_mem (by simpa using hp)
  simp [haone]

theorem normal_closure_killed
    (rho : G →* Q) (p : Q →* P) (A : I → Subgroup Q)
    (S : Set G)
    (hdetect : ∀ i, Set.InjOn p (A i : Set Q))
    (hlocal : ∀ s ∈ S, ∃ i a g, a ∈ A i ∧ rho s = g * a * g⁻¹)
    (hfinite : ∀ s ∈ S, p (rho s) = 1) :
    Subgroup.normalClosure S ≤ rho.ker := by
  apply Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
  intro s hs
  change rho s = 1
  rcases hlocal s hs with ⟨i, a, g, ha, heq⟩
  rw [heq]
  apply conjugate_kernel_trivial p (A i) (hdetect i) ha g
  rw [← heq]
  exact hfinite s hs

theorem descent_exists
    (rho : G →* Q) (p : Q →* P) (A : I → Subgroup Q)
    (S : Set G)
    (hdetect : ∀ i, Set.InjOn p (A i : Set Q))
    (hlocal : ∀ s ∈ S, ∃ i a g, a ∈ A i ∧ rho s = g * a * g⁻¹)
    (hfinite : ∀ s ∈ S, p (rho s) = 1) :
    ∃ descended : G ⧸ Subgroup.normalClosure S →* Q,
      ∀ g, descended (QuotientGroup.mk g) = rho g := by
  have hker := normal_closure_killed rho p A S hdetect hlocal hfinite
  refine ⟨QuotientGroup.lift (Subgroup.normalClosure S) rho hker, ?_⟩
  intro g
  rfl

end SurfaceGeometry

claims.natural_statement: Given the geometric_input, a finite quotient of Q injective on every whole local boundary-image group yields a connected finite Galois cover of U whose rho descends across a smooth projective SNC compactification, including every exceptional meridian, while preserving the already smooth SNC locus of its normalization.

Under geometric_input and S_LOCAL, the actual normalized inverse image of the distinguished fiber is already smooth SNC locally with maps (u,w)->(u,w^e) at horizontal intersections; prescribed-open resolution leaves it unchanged, and its reduced components are smooth rational curves meeting only in nodes.

Under geometric_input and the cover in S_LOCAL, a connected component of the distinguished reduced compact rational fiber has infinite image in pi1 of the final projective surface, by dense intersection with an open infinite subgroup and proper specialization through a compatible-triangulation neighborhood retraction.

If a compact connected nodal curve of smooth rational components in a complex manifold has infinite fundamental-group image, each connected pullback to the universal cover is a closed noncompact locally finite rational string; every ambient holomorphic function is constant on it, so the hull of each of its points is noncompact.

For the actual star fiber under S_RATIONAL and finite Galois group P, with k tails and marking images a_j of orders e_j, the graph has main vertices P, tail vertices P/<a_j>, and edges (p,j) from p to p<a_j>. With H=<a_j> it has [P:H] components and total first Betti number |P|(k-1)-sum_j |P|/e_j+[P:H]; accepted pair factorization makes H=P.

For every reviewed n=2^r with r>=2, the actual quotient and geometric_input yield a smooth connected projective complex surface containing a connected rational nodal curve of infinite fundamental-group image with the stated coset graph; its universal cover is not holomorphically convex. This is the geometric implication conditional on the accepted quotient, not whole-theorem Lean verification.

On Y=P1 x P1 with coordinate boundary and U=(C*)^2, the map rho:Z^2->C2 x C2 given by coordinate parities followed by addition to C2 detects each component cyclic subgroup but not the full crossing group; the normalization z^2=uv has a resolution exceptional meridian (1,1) with nontrivial rho-image, so rho does not descend.

For every n=2^r with r>=2, the accepted actual paired elliptic sphere-family construction gives an infinite pro-2 quotient Q with dense punctured fiber image, finite images of all boundary meridians, trivial distinguished vertical meridians, and a finite parameter cover of distinguished ramification index exactly two.
